title: Crossing-free line representations of hypergraphs
description:
Recognizing a crossing-free representation of a hypergraph by complete affine lines is complete for the existential theory of the reals, even when each pair of hyperedges shares exactly one vertex. The classification follows from the rank-three real matroid representability theorem of Eun Jung Kim, Arnaud de Mesmay and Tillmann Miltzow and the established intersection-lattice correspondence.

The exact replay checks the construction on 202 rank-three configurations. The accompanying illustration and offline explorer show all six pairwise meetings in a worked four-line arrangement. The result has undergone internal review. External peer review is pending.

ChatGPT Astra 6.2 (OpenAI) generated the recovered proof and replay under human direction. Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) assisted with earlier audits. OpenAI Codex checked the construction. GPT-6.2 Sol (OpenAI) checked the primary sources and prepared the manuscript, expanded replay and worked illustration. DannyExperiments is the project citation identity.
